history.summary: Freehold 393-unit D15 Siglap development (2014/2015), 2BR at $2.00M / $1,674psf on a roomy 1,195sqft. Well-maintained hilltop estate with active en-bloc interest. Solid 4.62% URA over 109 transactions, frontier, strong arena score (769). Asking PSF sits well below the $1,898 median — value for a freehold in a deep East Coast buyer pool.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold in tightly-held Siglap/East Coast with a clean 4.62%/yr URA (109 txns, no bias), priced at $1,674psf vs a $1,898 median — a real discount, partly because the 1,195sqft layout is generous (low PSF, not low quality). 393 units and FH status give durable liquidity; reviews describe it as quiet, well-managed and family-friendly. En-bloc interest provides genuine optionality. The $2.00M quantum is the practical ceiling of the deep-pool band but still saleable. Strongest freehold value in the batch.
red_flags: $2.00M quantum at the upper edge of the deepest buyer band
En-bloc is optionality, not a certainty — FCL still holds majority
No MRT within easy walk (relies on buses/drive)
catalysts: Active en-bloc interest — freehold Siglap site with redevelopment appeal
Freehold + deep East Coast buyer pool = durable resale liquidity
Asking PSF ~12% under URA median provides a value cushion

history.summary: A freehold 2BR in established Siglap/East Coast asking $1,673 psf — genuinely below the project's ~$1,752 psf 12-month average, on deep transaction support (109 txns). Real cheapness vs verified recent comps, the strongest forward signal under v3.4.
history.rating_rationale: This is the cleanest value case of the five. Asking $1,673 psf is ~5% under Flamingo Valley's trailing-12-month average of $1,752 psf (range $1,296-$1,972), and the cheapness is corroborated by depth: appreciation drawn from 109 URA txns (4.62% CAGR) and a -9.7% premium vs the size cohort on a respectable 10 cohort txns — not a 1-2 comp quirk. The dossier carries zero red flags. Physically it is a well-regarded, low-density freehold (393 units, Japanese-architect design, resort landscaping) in a sticky, owner-occupier East Coast/Siglap micromarket, RCR-adjacent. Region matters: RCR realized fwd ~+3.5% is solidly positive (the old CCR-prestige prior is inverted). I am not crediting the 4.62% trailing CAGR as forward guarantee, but the combination of verified sub-market entry + freehold + established demand justifies a Buy. Confidence is medium not high: quantum is at $2.0M for a 2BR (rich absolute), transport is bus-reliant (Bedok/future Marine Parade TE not at the doorstep), and en-bloc hopes are unrealistic in the current 35%-ABSD developer environment.
red_flags: High absolute quantum ($2.0M) for a 2-bedroom narrows the resale buyer pool
Transport is bus-reliant; no MRT within easy walking distance
Freehold premium is already paid in — not a forward return edge by itself
catalysts: Asking ~5% below the project's own 12-mo average PSF — verified real value
Thomson-East Coast Line build-out improving D15 connectivity over the hold
East Coast/Siglap owner-occupier demand keeps the floor firm; freehold scarcity
